chunks: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Durust, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:

A man came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, what is the right of this son of mine?' He said: 'Make his name good, teach him good manners, and place him in a good position.'
ai.seo_question: What are the three main rights of a father towards his son according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated from Imam al-Rida (AS), establishes the triad of paternal duty: naming, moral education (adab), and environmental placement, which Shia scholars view as the foundation for raising a virtuous offspring. It underscores that parenting is not merely biological but a spiritual trust (amanah) requiring active cultivation of character and social standing. The emphasis on 'placing him in a good position' reflects the Shia understanding of the father's role in securing both physical and spiritual well-being for the child.
